goal: Signs on to Meridian Core, locates a member by member number, opens Funds Transfer, fills from-share/to-share/amount/memo, reviews on the Confirm Funds Transfer screen, and posts the transaction. Returns the confirmation number and posted amount. Handles member-not-found and rejected-transaction (e.g. share on HOLD, insufficient funds) as declared business outcomes.

business_outcome.message: The transaction failed validation (e.g. source share on hold, insufficient funds).
business_outcome.detail: Source share is HOLD and cannot be debited.
